content:
[L] high | middle of screen, reading pane message card | The customer message text "I click Export and nothing…" is clipped mid-word at the card's right edge, truncating the primary content.
[L] high | right column bottom | The details/snooze panel strip ("waiting-engineering", "2h / tomorrow / 3d") sits detached from any visible panel frame and its row extends to the window edge, while the composer below spans a different width — the two columns and composer have no shared bounding logic.
[L] high | bottom-left composer region | The composer panel starts at x≈322, hard against the conversation list, with no separator or margin, and its left edge does not align with either the reading pane above (x≈312) or the list — misregistered column boundaries.
[L] med | top-right of reading pane header | The "Supp…" sender-supplement text is truncated with an ellipsis immediately after the email address instead of wrapping or fading, losing information.
[L] med | left rail top | The filter rows ("search conver…", #, Apply, Filters, Reset, Sync now) form a cramped cluster where "Reset" and "Sync now" nearly touch and the search input truncates its own placeholder ("search conver...").
[S] med | left rail tabs | The tabs wrap onto two lines with uneven spacing ("All 6 / Active 3 / Pending 2" then "Closed 1" alone), a ragged, unaligned tab row.
[S] med | header of reading pane | The "Copilot" toggle and status dot float at far right with a large dead gap from the truncated "Supp…" text; the header row has no consistent right inset versus the cards below (card ends ~x=792, header elements ~x=760).
[S] med | conversation list rows | Inset varies row to row: first row is a highlighted card with left accent bar and side margins, subsequent rows are flat with different left offsets — the list mixes card and row treatments inconsistently.
[S] low | details panel fields | Label column ("Status/Assignee/Priority/State/Tags/Snooze") baselines don't align with their value rows; "State" chips row extends nearly full-bleed to the right edge with no padding while other rows keep a right margin.
[S] low | composer fields | "To", "Cc", "Bcc" label-value rows have inconsistent vertical gaps (To row tighter than Cc/Bcc) and the To value is plain text while Cc/Bcc are boxed inputs — inconsistent treatment of sibling fields.
[H] med | left rail | "All" heading, "6 of 6 conversations" metadata, and filter controls all render at similar size/weight, so section heading, stats, and controls read at one flat level.
[H] med | reading pane header | Subject "#501 Export broken" is only marginally bolder than the metadata line beneath it, and the truncated "Supp…" metadata sits at equal visual prominence to the subject.
[H] low | conversation list | Dates, sender name, subject, assignee, and status pill in each row compete at near-equal weight; subject (#501…) is not clearly the primary line versus metadata.
[H] low | details panel | Chip groups (active/pending/closed/spam; low/normal/high/urgent; new/investigating/…) all look identically styled so the five property groups blur together with no grouping headers or separation.
[C] med | gap between details panel and message area | A wide empty dead band (~y=360–390, including the floating "2026-02-16" date divider stranded in whitespace) separates the details strip from the message card with no structural element tying them together.
[C] med | overall three-column composition | Column proportions are unbalanced: the left rail (~310px) is nearly as wide as the reading column, crushing the conversation list into a narrow middle strip while the right edge of the details area bleeds to the window boundary.
[C] low | composer bottom | The footer line "reply — sent to the customer · Ctrl+Enter sends" reads like debug/log text mixed with a primary action (Send), at equal visual weight in the same row.
[C] low | left rail bottom | Large empty whitespace below the last conversation row (~y=880+) with no affordance, making the list column visibly under-filled versus the dense right column.

VERDICT: unprofessional — truncated text, misregistered column edges, inconsistent card/row treatments, and flat typographic hierarchy make this read as a prototype, not a product.
